title: Modular Operation Theatres — Astana Medical Campus (Phase 1)
description: Design, supply, install and commission modular operation theatres for the Astana Medical Campus Phase 1. Scope covers 8 OTs with laminar-flow ceilings, medical-gas pipeline systems, HVAC, integration with hospital BMS, commissioning, training and 24-month AMC.

title: External Power Supply Grid Connection — University Precinct
description: Design and construct the external 110/10 kV grid connection for the university precinct including switchyard, protection, telemetry and RTU tie-in to the national grid operator. Live commissioning coordinated with KEGOC.

title: Hostel Bathrooms & Plumbing — Blocks A–D
description: Supply and install sanitary fixtures, hot/cold-water distribution, waste stacks, vent lines and pressure-testing for hostel Blocks A through D (760 units total).
